name: Authority
summary: As an action, command one creature within 30 ft that can hear you. It must make a Wisdom saving throw. DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier. On a failure, choose one: the target is frightened until the end of your next turn; the target drops prone; or the target drops one held item. Uses: proficiency bonus per long rest.
